**Finding submitted: INSURANCE — missing (fallback cure).**

- **Investigation:** Searched the whole document for "insurance", "coverage", "certificate", "policy" and "workers compensation"; the only hit is the definitional deduction for "taxes, freight, insurance, refunds or credits" in § 1. Read § 14 (Miscellaneous) in full and § 8 (Indemnification) — neither imposes any insurance covenant, and no exhibit carries one.
- **Direction:** Commerce One is the vendor (software licensor plus installation support, maintenance and training), so the obligation runs against the counterparty and is properly flagged.
- **Cure:** One `insert_after` in Miscellaneous carrying only the two fallback elements — E&O of not less than USD 1,000,000 and cyber/privacy of not less than USD 2,000,000. No CGL, workers' compensation, certificates, term-tail or at-own-expense language was volunteered, since those sit only at the preferred level; the rationale notes they remain available on negotiation.
